notes.title: Fixed more bugs
notes.content:
Fixed 3 bugs (courtesy of R.N. Roveleh for spotting these):

1) Before, when you were defeated by the ghost in the repeating corridor, the dark overlay would still be on the screen when you respawn in the speakeasy. This has been removed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502488/54f8d61cbfad155b66643699492d02c2e4ea6ef4.jpg[/img]

2) Camera goes out of bound when you try to fetch the blue potion on the left side of the screen in the Classical Department Museum level. I moved the blue potion closer to the middle of the room to avoid this issue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502488/69471b695bb27e175e7a610b0228a98eba7607f1.jpg[/img]

3) After defeating the NPC Tamara, the game crashes due to "Object ID 36" not being found. It turned out that Object ID 36 referred to the copy of the player character I pasted into that level for playtesting. I didn't debug that level so there were still references to that Object ID even though I had deleted that copy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44502488/dfe309e456bbc927c7934a651cce975073f898bf.jpg[/img]
